examples.title: Flowchart with subgraphs
examples.description: A delivery pipeline: a push is built and tested, a green build goes to staging and, after its smoke tests, to production; a failure leads back to a fix.
examples.source:
flowchart TD
  subgraph ci [Continuous integration]
    push[Push to main] --> build[Build] --> tests{Tests pass?}
  end
  subgraph cd [Delivery]
    staging[Deploy to staging] --> smoke{Smoke tests}
    smoke -->|green| production[Deploy to production]
  end
  tests -->|yes| staging
  tests -->|no| fix[Fix the build]
  smoke -->|red| rollback[Roll back]
  rollback -.-> fix
  fix --> push

examples.title: Sequence with blocks and notes
examples.description: A user signs in through an identity provider; the app trades the code for a token and then calls the API with it on every page.
examples.source:
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  actor User
  participant App
  participant Auth as Identity provider
  participant API
  User->>App: Open the dashboard
  App->>Auth: Redirect to sign-in
  activate Auth
  Auth-->>User: Sign-in form
  User->>Auth: Credentials
  alt Valid credentials
    Auth-->>App: Authorization code
  else Invalid credentials
    Auth-->>User: Error message
  end
  deactivate Auth
  App->>Auth: Exchange the code
  Auth-->>App: Access token
  loop Every page
    App->>API: Request with token
    API-->>App: JSON
  end
  Note over App,API: The token expires after an hour

examples.description: A library holds books by one or more authors; each book has copies, a copy can be lent, and a member borrows copies through loans.

examples.title: State diagram with composite states
examples.description: An order moves from the cart through a checkout of three steps; a choice on the payment sends it to fulfillment or back to the cart.
examples.source:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Cart
  Cart --> Checkout: check out
  state Checkout {
    [*] --> Address
    Address --> Payment
    Payment --> Confirmation
    Confirmation --> [*]
  }
  state paid <<choice>>
  Checkout --> paid
  paid --> Fulfillment: accepted
  paid --> Cart: declined
  state Fulfillment {
    [*] --> Picking
    Picking --> Packed
    Packed --> Shipped
    Shipped --> [*]
  }
  Fulfillment --> Delivered
  Delivered --> [*]
  note right of Cart: Items can be added at any time

examples.title: Entity relationship
examples.description: A shop schema: customers place orders of line items, each line item names a product, products belong to categories and customers keep addresses.
examples.source:
erDiagram
  CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places
  ORDER ||--|{ LINE_ITEM : contains
  PRODUCT ||--o{ LINE_ITEM : "ordered as"
  CATEGORY ||--o{ PRODUCT : groups
  CUSTOMER ||--o{ ADDRESS : "ships to"
  CUSTOMER {
    int id PK
    string name
    string email UK
  }
  ORDER {
    int id PK
    int customer_id FK
    date placed
    string status
  }
  LINE_ITEM {
    int order_id FK
    int product_id FK
    int quantity
  }
  PRODUCT {
    int id PK
    string title
    decimal price
  }

examples.title: Gantt chart
examples.description: A release plan in three sections: design, then the engine, the command line and its documentation in parallel, then a beta and the release.
examples.source:
gantt
  title Release 2.0
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  axisFormat %b %d
  todayMarker off
  section Design
    Requirements   :done, req, 2026-01-05, 5d
    Architecture   :done, arch, after req, 4d
  section Build
    Core engine    :active, core, after arch, 10d
    Command line   :cli, after arch, 6d
    Documentation  :docs, after cli, 5d
  section Ship
    Beta           :milestone, beta, after core, 0d
    Release        :crit, release, after docs core, 3d

examples.title: Git graph
examples.description: A feature branch and a hotfix leave main; the hotfix is merged and tagged, main is merged into the feature, and the feature is merged and tagged.
examples.source:
gitGraph
  commit id: "init"
  commit id: "readme"
  branch feature
  checkout feature
  commit id: "parser"
  commit id: "tests"
  checkout main
  branch hotfix
  checkout hotfix
  commit id: "fix crash"
  checkout main
  merge hotfix tag: "v1.0.1"
  checkout feature
  merge main
  commit id: "renderer"
  checkout main
  merge feature tag: "v1.1.0"
